words.sense: especially hard to manage, solve, or settle
misconceptions: Every difficult disagreement is caused by someone rejecting compromise

words.sense: refusing to change a position or make concessions
misconceptions: All hard-to-solve problems are matters of personal stubbornness

semantic_axes.description: A problem is intractable when extremely hard to solve; a stance is intransigent when its holder refuses concessions.

edges.boundary_rule: intractable is hard to solve; intransigent refuses to compromise.

misconceptions.M1: Mistakes difficulty of resolution for refusal to compromise
misconceptions.M2: Mistakes personal inflexibility for inherent complexity
misconceptions.M3: Treats mere disagreement as proof of either stronger label

chains.frame: Which word best describes the scheduling problem Leena faced?

beats.text: Leena could not find a timetable that accommodated all eight classes, despite testing dozens of combinations.
beats.decisive_clue: numerous combinations failed to solve a difficult puzzle
beats.reason: The issue is stubborn complexity of the problem.

beats.text: She tried a second scheduling app, but the same clashes appeared.
beats.decisive_clue: problem resisted another method
beats.reason: Multiple failed methods confirm severe difficulty.

chains.feedback_short: Key evidence: problem resisted another method.
chains.feedback_deep: intractable means extremely difficult to handle or resolve; intransigent means unwilling to reconsider a stance or compromise. The issue is stubborn complexity of the problem. Multiple failed methods confirm severe difficulty.
chains.contrast_rule: intractable is hard to solve; intransigent refuses to compromise.

hints.attention: Examine the problem, not anyone's attitude.
hints.axis: A problem is intractable when extremely hard to solve; a stance is intransigent when its holder refuses concessions.
hints.contrast: intractable is hard to solve; intransigent refuses to compromise.

beats.decisive_clue: refused to change any demand or consider compromises
